description: Configure third-party sign-in providers. Secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned to the browser. Changes take effect on the login page and profile immediately after saving.

form.inheritHint: Use -1 or “Follow global” for role, points and IP limits to use the registration settings defaults.
form.extraConfigHint: Generic OAuth2 reads id, username, name, avatar_url and email by default. Configure custom field mappings or token auth style through the management API; existing extra config is preserved when saving.
form.qqWechatEmailHint: QQ/WeChat do not provide email. If the global policy requires a verified email, explicitly select “Email not required” here or registration will be rejected.
form.providerKeyInvalid: Provider key must contain lower-case letters, digits and underscores, 2 to 32 characters

form.registerIpHourLimit: Registration limit per IP per hour
form.registerIpMaxAccounts: Lifetime accounts per IP per provider
form.secretKeep: Configured. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
